svg.title: CloudOps Multi-Agent solution architecture
svg.desc: A left-to-right AWS architecture with a supervisor fan-out into domain lanes, scalable specialist agents, AgentCore Gateway and Lambda tools, a separate browser service path, and a cross-cutting security and operations foundation.
svg.text: AgentCore Runtime hosting scalable Strands agents
Grouped service APIs and account data
Sessions, reports and the low-latency network visualizer path
applies across browser, agent and tool paths
